reviews.justification: TypeScript emits an uncallable fallback while lowering the parameterless Nest Catch decorator; application control flow cannot select it.

The abort listener is registered with once semantics and removed in finally; no asynchronous boundary exists between marking the client released and removing that listener, so it cannot re-enter after release.
This closes the narrow abort race after acquisition resolves and before transaction setup resumes; the public abort contract is covered before acquisition, during acquisition, and during active work.

This closes the event-loop race between abort-listener registration and entering Promise.race; acquisition cancellation and late connection settlement are exercised through the public transaction seam.
